about_the_game:
⭐ “Finally, a tool that makes Database Design fast, not frustrating.”


After manually writing SQL, setting up schemas, and maintaining endless documentation, I realized there had to be a better way. That’s why I created Database Designer — a no-code PostgreSQL design tool that builds complete databases automatically, saving developers hours of repetitive work.

With just a few clicks, Database Designer generates:

  • ✅ SQL files — including schemas, tables, references, and indexes.

  • 📘 Markdown documentation — cleanly formatted and ready to export.

  • 💻 Entity Framework friendly C# classes — fully compatible and ready for integration.

Everything runs completely locally, ensuring your data stays private and secure. Database Designer leverages Pariah Cybersecurity v2, am open source, post-quantum–resistant cryptography library developed by Walker Industries, keeping your projects future-proof and safe. We use only NIST approved functions like KYBERS CRYSTAL and AES256 to save your data.

This tool started as an internal tool, but it quickly evolved into something much bigger. Along the way, I had incredible collaborators:

  • 🎨 Kennaness created most of the art assets, giving the interface a polished and intuitive look.

  • 🛠️ jpena173 contributed heavily to backend development, helping refine the architecture and optimize performance.

I also want to give a special thank you to my good friends

  • Ares for their consistent and direct feedback on the best course for developing Database Designer and

  • IiErickiI for constantly giving great UI/UX feedback and helping me make Database Designer feel good to use

Without them, I don't think Database Designer would be where it is now!

Whether you’re a solo developer, a small studio, or part of a larger team, Database Designer makes building and managing databases easier, faster, and even enjoyable. It’s perfect for developers who’d rather design than debug, whether you’re learning PostgreSQL, experimenting with new schemas, or building production applications.

🛠️ Key Features

  • No-code PostgreSQL database creation

  • Auto-generated SQL, documentation in Markdown, and Entity Framework -ready C# models

  • Completely offline, local operation with optional cloud solutions and one click deployment coming later

  • PQC-resistant cryptography for enhanced security

  • Fast, intuitive interface designed with usability in mind

  • GUI version in active development with customizable database functions
